title: Feedback opportunity discovery and prioritization
description:
Purpose: Give operators complete, evidence-based portfolio discovery that identifies and ranks optimization opportunities without silently sampling or overstating incomplete evidence.

Exclusions:
- Automatic score mutation or promotion.
- Hidden qualitative weighting.
- Client-specific prioritization rules or data.

Dependencies: Consumes generic feedback and coverage data. It may proceed independently of execution and candidate-generation work.

Definition of Done:
- Complete portfolio enumeration reports explicit coverage.
- Opportunity ranking exposes transparent disagreement volume, drift, evidence sufficiency, rubric clarity, and fixability signals.
- Partial evidence is labeled incomplete.
- Results provide actionable, compact recommendations suitable for choosing optimization targets.
- Behavior-first specifications and focused tests pass.

Running log: Record sanitized decisions, attempts, outcomes, and next steps in this epic or its child issues.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Started the scoped-ranking increment under story plx-5359ea. The implementation will preserve exhaustive account enumeration, apply exact-ID and literal case-insensitive prefix selectors before bounded feedback analysis, retain opaque IDs, and fail closed on incomplete coverage. No alternate execution path or fuzzy selector is being added.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Started the living optimization reporting increment on the combined integration branch. Work is split into living report and workbook persistence, authoritative human actions and dashboard inbox, and end-to-end portfolio orchestration. The implementation will keep report artifacts single-path, preserve immutable evidence revisions, fail closed on report divergence or stale approvals, and retain existing chat HITL compatibility. No external delivery adapter or automatic score mutation is included.
